warning_text: GOVERNMENT WARNING  : (1) ACCORDING TO THE SURGEON GENERAL,  WOMEN SHOULD NOT DRINK ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES DURING PREGNANCY BECAUSE OF THE RISK OF BIRTH DEFECTS. (2) CONSUMPTION OF ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES IMPAIRS YOUR ABILITY TO DRIVE A CAR OR OPERATE MACHINERY,  AND MAY CAUSE HEALTH PROBLEMS.
notes: Brand read from the front logo as 'Lucky Lucy's' in mixed case with a curly apostrophe.
ABV and net contents read from the front, bottom two lines: '40%ALC/VOL/80 PROOF' and '1 LITER/ MADE IN THE USA'; the net contents wording is '1 LITER'.
Warning is on the back, body in capitals. A wider-than-normal gap sits before the heading's colon, and after 'GENERAL,' and 'MACHINERY,'; transcribed as double spaces.
